description: Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen - Movimiento mensual de pasajeros is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Número de pasajeros que transitaron mensualmente en la terminal durante 2019, clasificados en entrada, salida y en transferencia. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 27 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Its tags are aviación, estadística de pasajeros 2019, movimiento de pasajeros, pasajeros, pasajeros Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-07-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
